committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 27 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend fell to $110.95 from $173.41 and clicks to 20 from 27, yet conversions are still zero. Post restart clicks sit at 64 of the 150 stop loss threshold, so the test keeps running for now.

Rank lost 30d is 73.5 percent against budget lost 30d of 21.7 percent, so the constraint is rank not budget and the budget conversation stays closed. CTR last7 improved to 4.2 percent from 3.1 percent even as impression share sits at only 10 percent.

Sessions last7 dropped to 44 from 59, a 25 percent fall, with Sat 26 the softest day at 1 session against 4 on the same weekday last week. The calculator saw its first use in a week, 1 versus 0 prior7, still a thin signal off /ai-automation-agency.html which led landing pages with 18 sessions.

AI Assistant sessions eased to 1 from 2, chatgpt.com the only named source, and this figure undercounts since many AI referrals land untagged in Direct. LinkedIn posted its first session, so Chris's recent posting may finally be tagged. Organic Search ticked up to 12 from 9 but remains the only unpaid channel worth trusting.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword matched RSA headlines for the serving ad groups are still outstanding, get them into the account.
Fix the homepage form to confirm then count, so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree verdict rather than firing before it.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, update the line to match current site stats.
